result:
I’ll trace scorer reconstruction and guardrail loading, then add the server-side restriction and focused tests. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill for this change.
Scorer reconstruction already funnels through one method, so I can make decorator scorers inert there before any source code runs. Executor permission will be process-local, not an environment variable. Guardrail creation and loading will separately reject decorator scorers, including those nested in ensembles.
The focused tests confirm that server-side loading does not evaluate function defaults, even with custom scorers enabled or a Databricks tracking URI. Client and executor reconstruction still work. I’m checking guardrail rejection in both workspace modes; the first run also exposed a test assertion to fix and a sandbox restriction in pytest’s diagnostic hook.
All 140 focused scorer, serialization, and guardrail-store tests passed, including workspace-enabled cases. Pytest then hit a sandbox permission error in its process-reporting hook. A separate guardrail test run had three tracing failures (“expected 1 trace, got 0”); the guardrail loading tests passed. I’m finishing the diff review and updating comments to describe the new execution boundary.
Implemented inert custom-scorer loading in the server, preserving metadata and serialization while rejecting execution. Job executors retain process-local execution permission; client behavior is unchanged.

Custom guardrails, including ensembles, are rejected at creation and loading. Existing ones return HTTP 500 naming the guardrail; other loading failures remain logged and skipped.

Validation: 140 focused tests passed. Three additional tracing tests failed with missing traces, and pytest’s diagnostic hook hit a sandbox permission error. No dependencies installed.

+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import asdict
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest

+import mlflow.server
+from mlflow.exceptions import MlflowException
+from mlflow.genai.judges import make_judge

+from mlflow.genai.scorers import scorer_utils
+from mlflow.genai.scorers.base import ScorerKind, SerializedScorer
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("enabled", ["true", "false"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tracking_uri", ["databricks", "sqlite://"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("session_level", [True, False])
+def test_server_custom_scorer_is_inert(monkeypatch, tmp_path, enabled, tracking_uri, session_level):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mlflow.server, "is_running_as_server", True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(scorer_utils, "_job_executor_pid", None)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MLFLOW_SERVER_ENABLE_CUSTOM_SCORERS", enabled)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI", tracking_uri)
+    marker = tmp_path / "executed"
+    serialized = SerializedScorer(
+        name="custom",
+        description="Metadata only",
+        aggregations=["mean"],
+        timeout=13,
+        is_session_level_scorer=session_level,
+        call_source="return True",
+        # Default expressions execute when the function is rebuilt, before it is called.
+        call_signature=f"(outputs=__import__('pathlib').Path({str(marker)!r}).touch())",
+        original_func_name="custom",
+    )
+    loaded = Scorer.model_validate_json(json.dumps(asdict(serialized)))
+    assert not marker.exists()
+    assert loaded.model_dump() == asdict(serialized)
+    assert loaded.name == serialized.name
+    assert loaded.description == serialized.description
+    assert loaded.aggregations == serialized.aggregations
+    assert loaded.timeout == serialized.timeout
+    assert loaded.kind == ScorerKind.DECORATOR
+    assert loaded.is_session_level_scorer == session_level
+    for invoke in (loaded, loaded.run):
+        with pytest.raises(MlflowException, match="cannot run in the tracking server"):
+            invoke(outputs="hello")
+    assert not marker.exists()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("server", [True, False])
+def test_executor_and_client_reconstruct_custom_scorer(monkeypatch, server):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mlflow.server, "is_running_as_server", server)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(scorer_utils, "_job_executor_pid", None)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MLFLOW_SERVER_ENABLE_CUSTOM_SCORERS", "true")
+    payload = {
+        "name": "custom",
+        "call_source": "return outputs == 'hello'",
+        "call_signature": "(outputs)",
+        "original_func_name": "custom",
+    }
+    if server:
+        payload = Scorer.model_validate(payload).model_dump()
+        scorer_utils._mark_job_executor_process()
+    loaded = Scorer.model_validate(payload)
+    assert loaded(outputs="hello") is True
+    assert loaded(outputs="other") is False
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("executor_pid", [None, os.getpid() + 1])
+def test_executor_permission_is_process_local(monkeypatch, executor_pid):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mlflow.server, "is_running_as_server", True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(scorer_utils, "_job_executor_pid", executor_pid)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("_MLFLOW_SERVER_JOB_ID", "inherited-job-id")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("_MLFLOW_SERVER_JOB_NAME", "inherited-job-name")
+    assert scorer_utils._load_scorer_as_metadata()
+
+
+def test_server_ensemble_does_not_reconstruct_custom_code(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mlflow.server, "is_running_as_server", True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(scorer_utils, "_job_executor_pid", None)
+    payload = {
+        "name": "ensemble",
+        "ensemble_scorer_data": {
+            "ensemble_fn": "majority_vote",
+            "scorers": [{
+                "name": "custom",
+                "call_source": "return True",
+                "call_signature": "(outputs)",
+                "original_func_name": "custom",
+            }],
+        },
+    }
+    with mock.patch("mlflow.genai.scorers.scorer_utils.recreate_function") as recreate:
+        loaded = Scorer.model_validate(payload)
+    recreate.assert_not_called()
+    nested = loaded.model_dump()["ensemble_scorer_data"]["scorers"][0]
+    expected = SerializedScorer.from_dict(payload["ensemble_scorer_data"]["scorers"][0])
+    assert nested == asdict(expected)
